sanskrit_verse:
प्रवेशनादिकं कर्म प्रेतसंस्पर्शिनामपि ।
इच्छतां तत्क्षणाच्छुद्धिः परेषां स्नानसंयमान् ॥१४॥
transliteration: praveśanādikaṃ karma pretasaṃsparśinām api | icchatāṃ tatkṣaṇācchuddhiḥ pareṣāṃ snānasaṃyamān ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who come into contact with the deceased or perform related duties attain immediate purification upon willing it, through the disciplined bathing practices prescribed for others.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious will, not ritual formality
Causation arises through intent-aligned action, not external imposition
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by spiritual readiness, not social role
Restoration logic operates through self-initiated purification, not punitive cleansing
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.contacts(deceased) AND agent.intends(purification): THEN execute(bathing_protocol)
IF agent.is_ready_for_duty AND agent.follows(snānasaṃyamān): THEN grant(immediate_shuddhi_status)
supreme_court_application: In matters involving ritual purity and eligibility for sacred duty, the Supreme Court shall recognize that purification is a function of conscious volition and disciplined practice, not mere procedural compliance. Legal standing in dharma-related cases must account for internal readiness over external appearances.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that purity is known through intent and disciplined action. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that contamination dissolves instantaneously when purified will activates. Proportional responsibility lies in maintaining alignment with śuddhi-prescribed conduct. The non-punitive reality rule confirms that no impurity inheres permanently; all states are transient based on consciousness orientation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Will-Based Purification Process upon declaration of intent
Assign Supervised Bathing Discipline under qualified guide
Verify Conscious Readiness before re-entry into sacred service
Complete Self-Reflection Module on Death Contact Implications
Reintegrate through Communal Acknowledgment of Restoration
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law executes pure Dharma. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. All beings are restored through willing alignment.
